rationale: The assistant gave the right stop-use advice, told the customer not to keep resetting the RCD, and pointed to an engineer or electrician. It named likely earth leakage in the heating elements with suitable hedging. It asked no follow-up questions, such as whether anything smells burnt or whether the grill alone trips it, and it said nothing about isolating at the cooker switch. It also claimed 'From what you have checked', though the customer had not done any checks, and it said 'unplugged' for a built-in oven that is hardwired. It escalated at once, so the customer got little diagnostic help beyond the generic cause.
